answer: A payout is split so that 37% arrives at settlement and the rest over 15 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The river schedule is applied in glacier and saffron makes public each instalment. An farming party hence cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 847 identities would post 3985 proofs and burn roughly 66 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
